verdict.rationale: An llms.txt exists at jumpcloud.com/llms.txt, but its quoted content is marketing-level positioning rather than technical docs. The docs subdomain returns 404 for llms.txt and markdown docs, though a machine-readable OpenAPI YAML is published at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml. These are different hosts rather than a contradiction, so an agent gets a basic entry point but not a rich agent-oriented docs surface. Missing for 10: llms.txt on the docs site, markdown/agent-oriented versions of the technical docs, evidence the llms.txt indexes API/admin documentation, independent corroboration of agent use.
